name: Deshabhimani news text from the SMC Malayalam corpus
licence: Unclear: the SMC README says CC BY 4.0; Deshabhimani's own terms of use say CC BY-SA 4.0 ("India", "or later") unless otherwise specified; the same site's footer says "All Rights Reserved".
licence_source: https://gitlab.com/smc/corpus/-/blob/master/text/deshabhimani/README.md; https://www.deshabhimani.com/terms-of-use (read via the Wayback Machine 2024 snapshot; the live site is behind a Cloudflare challenge).
attribution: News text from Deshabhimani (deshabhimani.com), January 2023 to April 2024, collected by Swathanthra Malayalam Computing.
verdict_reason: The publisher's terms do grant CC BY-SA, but they conflict with the footer, and news pages carry agency copy that 'unless otherwise specified' would exclude. Good as held-out modern Malayalam prose; upgrade to use only after confirming the terms with the live site or the publisher.
used_for: M3b only: held-out sentences for LM evaluation.
notes: news.txt is 114,524,376 bytes (GitLab API), over the 50 MB limit for this audit. Pin commit d1e6431d0b05147056d873a3998cdedc2c7d573c when fetching.
